task.description: Elevate benchwork into the full autonomous lifecycle hub, after SP-14 makes worktrees safe. WorktreeAgentPool in benchwork-core dispatches 1..N background agent workers from Panel 2 (a Dispatch Worker action on any Ready task plus an auto-drain queue toggle over storypole next), each isolated in its own .gaugeblock/worktrees/<KEY>, streaming live progress, PlanStep checkboxes, gate output and diff previews into Panel 3 X-Ray and Benji. benchwork-cli remains the single daemon at :4242 so a future thin VS Code plugin attaches to it instead of reimplementing the loop. Blocked by SP-14: dispatching into worktrees before canonical .gaugeblock resolution exists would hand every worker its own ledger.
task.title: benchwork WorktreeAgentPool: dispatch and observe N isolated agent workers from the daemon
